settings.dateFormat: ISO: reconcile-tests renders without setting it, after trep-tests set it (:70); no check reads a date

book: The reconcile tree of reconcile-tests (:1077-1104): the structure of :85-97, every account USD, and the seven 1969-1970 transfers of :182-190 except that trn7 goes from Bank to Expenses. GnuCash builds it in the same book as the trep and invoice trees; the report reads only this tree's Bank and Liabilities, so it has its own book here (design/notes/report-transaction-engine.md §4.5).

dates.start-prev-quarter: 2023-12-15 00:00:00 UTC for the pinned now: quarters count from the start of the accounting period, today, the 15th (5.17:libgnucash/engine/gnc-option-date.cpp:487-512, :519-596)

optionValues: Options are those the test sets; the rest are the template's defaults (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/reconcile-report.scm:34-58): Primary Key reconciled-status, Secondary Key date with no date subtotal, Start Date start-prev-quarter, End Date today, Date Filter reconciled, Reconciled Date and no Memo. {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with get-row-col (:73-74), sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table 1; row N the Nth row of <tbody>, column null every cell; the result is every text in document order, so empty cells drop out.
